findings.note: "Getting clear early usually creates more options, not fewer." No ledger claim or stored passage supports this frequency claim. Reword to a non-statistical statement, for example that getting clear early can leave you more options.

"A packed house is often a family matter before it is a real estate matter, and nobody should be judged for it." The "often ... before" frequency claim has no support in the ledger. Reword to something like "A packed house can be a family matter as well as a real estate matter, and you should not feel judged for it."
"Many people in this spot are not avoiding the problem." A claim about what many people do, with no ledger support. Consider "You may not be avoiding the problem."
